name: Command Re-Roll
turn: Immediately after rolling any single die
effect: Reroll that single die (Hit, Wound, Save, Damage, Charge, or Hazard roll).

name: Fire Overwatch
turn: Right after an enemy unit finishes a Move within 18" of a Ready unit
effect: Your unengaged unit fires 1 ranged attack at that enemy, hitting ONLY on natural 6s. Does not exhaust the unit.

name: Heroic Intervention
turn: Right after an enemy finishes a Charge within 6" of an unengaged friendly unit
effect: Your unit immediately makes a D6" Counter-Charge into that enemy unit to join the clash!

name: Counter-Offensive
turn: In Melee, right after an enemy unit has finished resolving its attacks
effect: Your engaged unit gains [STRIKE FIRST]—interrupting the melee chain to strike next before remaining enemy units!

name: Epic Challenge
turn: When your Leader / Character is selected to fight in Melee
effect: That Leader's melee attacks gain [PRECISION] for this clash to duel the enemy Leader directly through bodyguards.

name: Shrapnel Grenades
turn: During a unit's activation instead of shooting (within 8" of an unengaged enemy)
effect: Roll 6D6: each 4+ inflicts 1 Fatal Wound on the target enemy unit.

name: Crushing Impact
turn: Right after a Class 4 or 5 unit finishes a Charge move
effect: Roll D6s equal to the model's current MIGHT (max 8): each 5+ deals 1 Fatal Wound to the enemy; each 1 deals 1 Fatal Wound to yourself!

name: Smokescreen / Brace
turn: When your unit is targeted by an enemy Shooting attack
effect: Your unit gains the Benefit of Cover (-1 to Hit) and reduces incoming weapon PEN by 1 for that attack.

name: Rapid Vanguard
turn: At the end of an opponent's unit activation in Round 2 or 3
effect: Immediately deploy 1 of your [VANGUARD STRIKE] Reserve units onto the board (>8" from enemies) so it is ready to activate later this round.

name: Relentless Overdrive
turn: When activating a Ready unit (Once per battle)
effect: That unit receives 3 Actions during this activation instead of 2 (still maximum 1 Shoot and maximum 1 Charge).
